agent/11x.tagline: AI sales workers that run outreach for you
agent/11x.overview: 11x builds AI 'digital workers' that act like virtual SDRs, handling sales outreach and pipeline tasks automatically. Its agents (such as Alice for outreach) research prospects, send personalized messages across channels, and book meetings so human teams can focus on closing.
capabilities: Automated multi-channel prospecting and personalized outreach
Lead research and enrichment before each message
Pipeline and follow-up management for RevOps and GTM teams
Meeting booking handled by the AI worker
useCases: Sales and RevOps teams that want to scale outbound without hiring more SDRs
Go-to-market teams needing consistent, always-on prospect follow-up
howTo: Visit 11x.ai and request a demo or sign up for access.
Connect your CRM and define your ideal customer profile and target accounts.
Configure the AI worker's outreach sequences, tone, and channels.
Review and approve the AI's drafted messages, then let it run and monitor booked meetings.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://11x.ai and book a demo to provision an AI sales worker

goodToKnow: 11x is a commercial SaaS platform, not open source, so pricing is custom and sales-led.
Outputs still benefit from human review; AI-sent outreach should follow your region's anti-spam and compliance rules.

agent/2501.tagline: Autonomous agents that operate your computer
agent/2501.overview: 2501 builds autonomous AI agents that can operate computer systems and carry out multi-step tasks on their own. The focus is on operations work where an agent reads context, plans, and then executes actions across software without constant human prompting.
capabilities: Autonomous, multi-step task execution on computer systems
Agents that plan and act without step-by-step human input
Designed for operational and back-office workflows
useCases: Operations teams wanting to automate repetitive computer-based workflows
Businesses exploring agents that can act, not just chat
howTo: Visit 2501.ai to learn about the platform and request access.
Define the operational task or workflow you want the agent to automate.
Give the agent the credentials or system access it needs, scoped narrowly.
Start with a low-risk task and supervise the first runs before widening its autonomy.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://2501.ai to request platform access

goodToKnow: Autonomous agents that operate systems carry real risk; always scope permissions tightly and supervise early.
This is an emerging commercial product, so capabilities and availability may change.

agent/42-problems--inc-.tagline: AI agents that drive customer success work
agent/42-problems--inc-.overview: 42 Problems (Delegate) builds AI agents that predict, prioritize, and act on customer-success and account-management tasks for B2B teams. The agents surface which accounts need attention and can take action so CS managers spend time where it matters most.
capabilities: Predicts which accounts are at risk or need action
Prioritizes customer-success and account-management tasks
Acts on routine CS workflows automatically
useCases: B2B customer-success teams managing many accounts at once
Account managers who want early warning on churn or expansion signals
howTo: Visit usedelegate.com to explore the product and request a demo.
Connect your CRM and customer-data sources.
Let the agent analyze accounts and review its prioritized recommendations.
Approve which actions the agent can take automatically versus suggest only.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://usedelegate.com to request a demo

goodToKnow: This is a commercial B2B platform; pricing is sales-led.
Predictions are only as good as the CRM data you connect, so clean data improves results.

agent/7ai.tagline: AI agents that detect and respond to threats
agent/7ai.overview: 7AI is a security platform that uses AI agents to detect threats and respond to them automatically. It aims to offload repetitive security operations work from human analysts so teams can cover more ground without burning out.
capabilities: AI-driven threat detection across security signals
Automated response actions to contain threats
Reduces manual triage load on security analysts
useCases: Security operations (SOC) teams overwhelmed by alert volume
Lean security teams that need to automate routine investigation
howTo: Visit 7ai.com to learn about the platform and request access.
Connect your security data sources and tooling.
Define which detections and responses the agents are allowed to run.
Start in a monitor-only mode, then enable automated responses once you trust it.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://7ai.com to request access

goodToKnow: Automated security response can be disruptive if misconfigured; begin in monitoring mode.
This is a commercial security product aimed at organizations, not individual learners.

agent/abacus-ai.tagline: Embed AI models into your own apps
agent/abacus-ai.overview: Abacus.AI is a platform for building and embedding AI models and features directly into your own applications. It covers the lifecycle from training and deploying models to serving predictions and adding LLM-powered features, so teams can ship AI without building all the infrastructure themselves.
capabilities: Train, deploy, and serve machine-learning models
Add LLM-powered features to your applications
End-to-end MLOps pipeline and prediction APIs
Pre-built AI services you can call from your product
useCases: Product teams that want to add AI features without building ML infrastructure
Data teams needing managed model training and deployment
howTo: Sign up at abacus.ai and create a project.
Connect your dataset or choose a pre-built use case.
Train or select a model, then deploy it to get an API endpoint.
Call the prediction or LLM endpoint from your application.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Sign up at https://abacus.ai and create your first project

goodToKnow: Abacus.AI is a paid managed platform; check pricing tiers before committing.
It covers a broad surface (ML + LLM), so expect a learning curve to use it fully.

agent/abanteai.tagline: A coding agent that lives in GitHub
agent/abanteai.overview: AbanteAI's Mentat is a coding agent that works directly inside GitHub to read and change your codebase. You point it at issues or tasks and it proposes code edits as pull requests, acting like an AI teammate that ships changes for you to review.
capabilities: Reads and understands your existing codebase
Makes code changes and opens pull requests
Works inside the normal GitHub workflow
useCases: Developers who want an AI agent to handle small tasks and fixes
Teams that want code changes delivered as reviewable PRs
howTo: Visit mentat.ai and connect your GitHub account or repository.
Assign it an issue or describe the change you want.
Let the agent draft the code changes as a pull request.
Review the PR like any teammate's, then merge or request changes.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://mentat.ai and connect a GitHub repo

goodToKnow: Always review AI-generated PRs carefully before merging, especially on production code.
Best suited to well-scoped tasks; large ambiguous changes still need human direction.

agent/ability-ai.tagline: AI that runs your marketing tasks
agent/ability-ai.overview: Ability AI is a tool that handles marketing work such as creating content and running campaigns for your business. It acts as an AI marketing helper so small teams can produce and ship marketing without a full department.
capabilities: Generates marketing content for your business
Helps plan and run marketing campaigns
Automates repetitive marketing tasks
useCases: Small businesses and founders without a dedicated marketing team
Marketers who want to offload routine content and campaign work
howTo: Visit ability.ai and sign up for access.
Describe your business, audience, and marketing goals.
Let the tool generate content or campaign drafts.
Review, edit for brand voice, and publish.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://ability.ai to sign up

goodToKnow: AI-generated marketing still needs a human pass for brand voice and accuracy.
This is a commercial product; confirm what channels and integrations it supports for your stack.

agent/adala.tagline: Autonomous agents that label your data
agent/adala.overview: Adala (Autonomous DAta Labeling Agent) is an open-source Python framework for building agents that label and process data reliably. You give it a ground-truth dataset to learn from, and its agents iteratively improve their labeling skills using an LLM runtime, making results more consistent than raw prompting.
capabilities: Build autonomous agents specialized in data labeling and processing
Ground agents in a labeled dataset for reliable, consistent output
Configure strict output formats and constraints per skill
Run as a Python library or as an HTTP server / REST API
Use LLM runtimes like OpenAI to power the agents
useCases: Data and ML teams that need to label large datasets consistently
Researchers building custom autonomous data-processing pipelines in Python
howTo: Install the package with pip.
Prepare a small ground-truth dataset that defines your labeling task.
Define an Agent with the skill(s) and output constraints you need.
Set an LLM runtime (e.g. OpenAI API key) and run the agent over your data.

example.label: Install (PyPI)
example.command: pip install adala

goodToKnow: It is open source (Apache-licensed) from HumanSignal; you supply your own LLM API key and pay those usage costs.
Requires Python 3.8+ and some coding; it is a framework, not a no-code tool.

agent/adept.tagline: Agents that take action across your software
agent/adept.overview: Adept builds AI agents that take actions across the software tools in your tech stack, not just answer questions. The goal is an AI teammate that can operate real applications to complete knowledge-work tasks end to end.
capabilities: Takes real actions inside business software, not just chat
Operates across multiple tools in a workflow
Aimed at automating knowledge-worker tasks
useCases: Teams wanting to automate workflows that span several SaaS tools
Enterprises exploring action-taking agents for knowledge work
howTo: Visit adept.ai to learn about the platform and current availability.
Identify a multi-tool workflow you want to automate.
Request access or a demo to pilot the agent on that workflow.
Supervise early runs and expand scope as reliability proves out.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://adept.ai to learn more and request access

goodToKnow: Adept is a research-driven commercial company; check current product availability before planning around it.
Action-taking agents need careful permission scoping on the tools they touch.

agent/adot.tagline: Decentralized search for AI and Web3
agent/adot.overview: Adot is a decentralized search network built for AI and Web3 applications. It aims to provide search and discovery infrastructure that AI agents and decentralized apps can query without relying on a single centralized provider.
capabilities: Decentralized search and discovery network
Designed to serve AI applications and agents
Built for Web3 / on-chain use cases
useCases: Web3 developers needing search infrastructure that isn't centralized
AI app builders wanting a decentralized data/discovery layer
howTo: Visit a.xyz to read the documentation and network overview.
Review how to query the network or run a node, per their docs.
Integrate the search API into your AI or Web3 application.
Test against your use case before relying on it in production.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://a.xyz to read the docs

goodToKnow: This is a Web3/crypto-adjacent project; evaluate token and network mechanics carefully.
Decentralized search is an emerging space, so maturity and uptime can vary.

agent/agency-ai.tagline: An agency building more reliable AI agents
agent/agency-ai.overview: Agency AI (Staf.ai / AgentOps) is an agency that builds AI agents designed to be more reliable than typical ones. It pairs hands-on agent development services with AgentOps, an open-source observability toolkit for monitoring agent behavior and cost.
capabilities: Custom AI agent development as a service
Focus on reliability and production-readiness
Backed by the open-source AgentOps observability SDK
useCases: Companies that want agents built for them rather than building in-house
Teams needing reliability and monitoring baked into their agents
howTo: Visit agents.staf.ai to learn about the agency's services.
For the open-source observability layer, install AgentOps with pip.
Add a few lines to initialize AgentOps in your agent code to track runs.
Review traces, costs, and failures in the AgentOps dashboard.

example.label: Install AgentOps (the open toolkit)
example.command: pip install agentops

goodToKnow: The agency itself is a paid service; the AgentOps SDK it builds on is open source (MIT).
If you mainly want monitoring, you can use AgentOps directly without engaging the agency.

agent/agency-swarm.tagline: Orchestrate teams of agents like a company
agent/agency-swarm.overview: Agency Swarm is an open-source Python framework for building multi-agent applications, built on top of the OpenAI Agents SDK. You define agents with real-world roles (CEO, developer, assistant) and connect them with directional communication flows so they collaborate like an organization.
capabilities: Define agents with distinct roles, instructions, and tools
Full control over each agent's prompts and behavior
Type-safe tools built with Pydantic models
Orchestrated, directional agent-to-agent communication
Built on the OpenAI Agents SDK
useCases: Developers building collaborative multi-agent 'agencies' for automation
Teams modeling a workflow as cooperating specialized agents
howTo: Install the framework with pip.
Define each agent with a role, instructions, and its tools.
Declare the communication flows that connect the agents.
Create the Agency and run it, observing how agents pass work between each other.

example.label: Install (PyPI)
example.command: pip install -U agency-swarm

goodToKnow: Open source and free to use, but it runs on the OpenAI Agents SDK, so you pay for the underlying LLM API calls.
If migrating from v0.x, check the official migration guide since the SDK-based version changed the API.

agent/agenta.overview: Agenta is an open-source LLMOps platform that brings prompt management, evaluation, and observability into one place. It gives teams a prompt playground, versioned prompt management, automated and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, and tracing so you can build reliable LLM apps with confidence.
capabilities: Prompt playground and versioned prompt management
Automated and LLM-as-a-judge evaluation of outputs
Observability and tracing for LLM and agent calls
Works with any LLM provider and framework
Self-host with Docker or use Agenta Cloud
useCases: Teams iterating on prompts who need to compare versions systematically
Developers wanting evaluation and monitoring before shipping LLM features
howTo: Use Agenta Cloud at cloud.agenta.ai, or self-host with the Docker setup.
For self-hosting, copy the example env file and start the Docker Compose stack.
Create an app and add your prompts in the playground.
Run evaluations and connect observability to trace production calls.

example.label: Self-host (Python SDK)
example.command: pip install agenta

goodToKnow: Open source under MIT; a hosted Cloud tier also exists if you don't want to self-host.
Self-hosting uses Docker Compose, so you'll need Docker and some setup effort.

agent/agent-ai.tagline: A marketplace and network for AI agents
agent/agent-ai.overview: agent.ai is a marketplace and professional network for finding, sharing, and connecting with AI agents. It's a place to discover ready-made agents, publish your own, and network around agent-building, rather than a single agent itself.
capabilities: Browse and discover existing AI agents
Publish and share agents you build
Network with other agent builders
useCases: People looking for an existing agent to solve a task
Builders who want distribution for the agents they create
howTo: Visit agent.ai and create an account.
Browse the marketplace to find agents for your use case.
Try an agent directly, or build and publish your own.
Connect with other builders in the network.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://agent.ai and create an account

goodToKnow: Quality varies across a marketplace; vet an agent before trusting it with sensitive tasks.
It's a directory/network, so the value depends on the agents others publish.

agent/agentbase-pro.tagline: No-code voice and text agents on your data
agent/agentbase-pro.overview: AgentBase PRO lets you build no-code AI voice and text agents trained on your own data. Without writing code, you connect your content and the platform produces agents that can answer questions and handle conversations by voice or chat.
capabilities: Build voice and text AI agents with no code
Train agents on your own data and documents
Deploy conversational agents for support or info
useCases: Non-technical teams that want a custom agent without developers
Businesses needing a voice or chat assistant trained on their content
howTo: Visit agentbase.pro and sign up.
Upload or connect the data you want the agent to learn from.
Configure the agent's voice/text behavior in the no-code builder.
Test it, then deploy to your channel of choice.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://agentbase.pro to build your first agent

goodToKnow: No-code tools trade some flexibility for ease; complex logic may hit limits.
Quality of answers depends heavily on the data you train it on.

agent/agentcoin-tv.overview: Agentcoin TV (now rebranded AITV) is a media platform where autonomous AI agents host round-the-clock livestreams on topics like DeFi, music, and sports. Viewers can interact in real time and shape where the conversation goes, blending streaming with autonomous agents.
capabilities: Autonomous AI agents that host live, 24/7 streams
Real-time viewer interaction that steers the content
Topic channels spanning DeFi, music, and sports
useCases: People curious about live, agent-driven media and entertainment
Web3 communities exploring interactive AI streaming
howTo: Visit agentcoin.org (AITV) to watch the live agent streams.
Join a stream and interact via the live chat.
Try steering the conversation to see how the agents respond.
Follow the project for new channels and agent hosts.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://agentcoin.org to watch the AI-hosted streams

goodToKnow: The project has rebranded to AITV, so expect naming and feature changes.
It is crypto/Web3-adjacent; treat any token or financial elements with caution.

agent/agentflow.tagline: Write AI workflows in plain Markdown
agent/agentflow.overview: Agentflow is a low-code, open-source framework for creating and running AI-powered workflows using Markdown and natural language. You describe what you want in plain English with logical control like loops and branching, and Agentflow executes it against any AI provider, local or hosted.
capabilities: Write workflows as natural-language Markdown instead of heavy code
Loops and conditional branching in plain English
Connect to any AI provider or run models locally
Extend with custom actions and tools in JavaScript
Run via a starter kit or the aflow CLI
useCases: People who want to automate with AI without writing full programs
Developers prototyping agent workflows quickly in Markdown
howTo: Make sure you have a JavaScript runtime like Node.js installed.
Scaffold a project with the starter kit: npm create agentflow@latest my-agents.
Write your workflow as a Markdown file using natural language.
Run it with the aflow CLI (e.g. npx aflow) and refine.

example.label: Scaffold a project
example.command: npm create agentflow@latest my-agents

goodToKnow: Open source, but the README warns it's early-stage and the API may still change.
You provide your own AI provider keys (or local models), so usage costs are yours.

agent/agentforce.tagline: Salesforce's platform for building AI agents
agent/agentforce.overview: Agentforce is Salesforce's platform for building AI agents that work alongside teams to support customers. It plugs into Salesforce data and workflows so agents can handle service interactions, resolve issues, and assist employees within the Salesforce ecosystem.
capabilities: Build AI agents on top of Salesforce data and workflows
Automate customer-service and support interactions
Agents that assist human teams inside Salesforce
Native integration with the Salesforce platform
useCases: Salesforce customers wanting AI agents in their existing CRM
Customer-service teams automating tier-1 support
howTo: If you use Salesforce, visit salesforce.com/agentforce to learn about access.
Identify the service or support workflow to automate.
Configure the agent's topics, actions, and guardrails in Salesforce.
Test in a sandbox, then roll out to live customer interactions.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://salesforce.com/agentforce (requires Salesforce)

goodToKnow: Agentforce is tied to the Salesforce ecosystem and its licensing, so it's most relevant if you already use Salesforce.
Set clear guardrails before letting agents act on live customer cases.

agent/agent-forge.tagline: A consultancy for building and adopting agents
agent/agent-forge.overview: Agent Forge is a consultancy that helps businesses build and adopt AI agents. Rather than a product you install, it's a services partner that works at the intersection of human cognition and AI to design and deploy agent solutions for organizations.
capabilities: Consulting on AI agent strategy and adoption
Custom agent design and implementation for businesses
Guidance on integrating agents into existing workflows
useCases: Organizations that want expert help building agents
Teams unsure how to start with agents and needing strategic guidance
howTo: Visit agentforge.net (or agentforge.ai) to learn about their services.
Reach out to describe your business goals and use case.
Scope an engagement to design and build the agent solution.
Collaborate through implementation and adoption.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://agentforge.net to inquire about consulting

goodToKnow: This is a services/consultancy offering, not a self-serve product or download.
Engagements are bespoke, so timeline and cost depend on your project.

agent/agentgenesis.tagline: Copy-paste components for RAG and agents
agent/agentgenesis.overview: AgentGenesis is an open-source library of copy-paste code snippets for building custom RAG pipelines and AI agents. Like a components gallery, you browse the pieces you need, copy the code into your project, and modify it freely; there's no npm package to install as a dependency.
capabilities: Ready-made code snippets for RAG pipelines and agents
Copy-paste components you fully own and can edit
Built around the modern JS/TS and LangChain.js ecosystem
No dependency lock-in since you paste code, not install a package
useCases: JavaScript/TypeScript developers building RAG or agent features fast
Builders who want full control over the code rather than a black-box library
howTo: Visit agentgenesis.dev and browse the available components.
Pick the RAG or agent snippet that fits your need.
Copy the code directly into your project (no npm install).
Modify and build on top of it for your use case.

example.label: Get started
example.command: Visit https://agentgenesis.dev and copy a component into your project

goodToKnow: It's not distributed via npm by design; you copy and own the code, so updates are manual.
Open source and community-built, so review snippets before using them in production.
